Question: Do you maintain a documented information security programme formally approved by executive management?
Evidence Required: Approved security policy set with an approval record

Question: Is a named individual accountable for information security (CISO or equivalent)? State the role title.
How many staff are dedicated to information security on a full-time basis?
Are security policies reviewed at least annually? State the date of the last review.
Do you report security performance metrics to executive management at least quarterly?
Do you operate a documented information security risk assessment methodology?
Evidence Required: Methodology document naming the scoring method

Question: When was your last enterprise information security risk assessment completed?
Is there a documented risk acceptance process with a defined approval authority?
Does your risk register include risks arising from your own suppliers?
Do you hold a current ISO/IEC 27001 certificate issued by an accredited certification body?
Evidence Required: Certificate showing certification body and accreditation mark

Question: State the exact scope of that certificate, transcribed as written on the certificate itself.
Do you provide a SOC 2 Type II report, and what period does it cover?
Evidence Required: Complete report including Section 4 test results

Question: Does that report use the CARVE-OUT or the INCLUSIVE method for sub-service organisations? Name every carved-out sub-service organisation.
List every exception, qualification or deviation in your most recent report, and its remediation status.
Evidence Required: Report Section 4 plus written remediation plan

Question: Is multi-factor authentication enforced for all personnel with access to customer data?
Is phishing-resistant MFA enforced for privileged and administrative accounts?
Is access granted on a documented least-privilege, role-based model?
How frequently are user access rights reviewed? State the date of the last completed review.
Evidence Required: Signed and dated access review record

Question: What is your service-level commitment for revoking access on employee termination?
Evidence Required: Procedure plus a sample completed revocation record

Question: Do you support SSO (SAML or OIDC) and automated provisioning and deprovisioning (SCIM) for customer administrators?
Is customer data encrypted at rest? State the algorithm and key length.
Is customer data encrypted in transit? State the minimum TLS version enforced.
How are encryption keys generated, stored and rotated? Is a customer-managed key option available?
Is customer data logically or physically segregated between tenants? Describe the mechanism.
Do you operate documented data retention and secure deletion schedules?
Do you deploy data loss prevention or egress monitoring on systems holding customer data?
Will you execute our Data Processing Agreement, or provide one satisfying GDPR Article 28(3)?
In which countries will our data be stored, processed and accessed from, including support access?
Where data leaves the EEA, which GDPR Article 46 transfer mechanism applies?
Evidence Required: Standard Contractual Clauses or adequacy reference, plus transfer impact assessment

Question: Have you appointed a Data Protection Officer or equivalent? Give the contact route.
Can you support data subject access, rectification and erasure requests, and within what period?
Do you maintain records of processing activities under GDPR Article 30?
Provide your complete current sub-processor list, with the service each performs and its location.
How much prior notice is given of a new or changed sub-processor, and do we have a right to object?
Do you security-assess your own sub-processors before engagement? To what standard?
Do you flow down equivalent security and privacy obligations to your sub-processors?
Do you follow a documented secure development lifecycle?
Is peer code review mandatory before any merge to a production branch?
Are development, test and production environments separated? Is production data ever used in lower environments?
Do you perform static and dynamic application security testing within the pipeline?
Evidence Required: Scan configuration and redacted sample output

Question: Do you maintain a software bill of materials and monitor third-party components for known vulnerabilities?
Evidence Required: SBOM sample or software composition analysis report

Question: Do you perform authenticated vulnerability scanning, and at what frequency?
Evidence Required: Scan schedule and redacted sample report

Question: State your remediation service levels by severity for Critical, High, Medium and Low findings.
Is an independent penetration test performed at least annually? Will you share the executive summary?
Evidence Required: Executive summary of the most recent test

Question: Do you operate a coordinated vulnerability disclosure or bug bounty programme?
Are security-relevant events logged centrally? For how many months are logs retained?
Is there 24x7 monitoring and alerting on security events? In-house or outsourced?
Can you provide customer-accessible audit logs of administrative activity within our tenant?
Do you alert on anomalous access to customer data, such as bulk export or mass download?
Do you maintain a documented incident response plan? When was it last exercised?
Evidence Required: Incident response plan plus dated exercise record

Question: Within how many hours will you notify us of a security incident affecting our data?
Who is the named security incident contact, and what is the out-of-hours escalation route?
Have you experienced a reportable security breach in the last 24 months? Describe it and the remediation.
Do you support customer forensic requests and preserve evidence to a defined standard?
State your contractual availability commitment and your achieved availability over the last 12 months.
Evidence Required: Service level agreement plus uptime report

Question: State the documented Recovery Time Objective and Recovery Point Objective for the service we consume.
Evidence Required: Business continuity or disaster recovery plan

Question: When was the disaster recovery plan last tested, and what was the documented result?
Are backups encrypted, and are restores tested at a defined frequency?
Evidence Required: Backup policy and a dated restore test record

Question: Can we export our complete dataset in a documented, machine-readable format on demand?
Are background checks performed on personnel with access to customer data, where lawful?
Do all personnel and contractors sign confidentiality agreements?
Is security awareness training mandatory at induction and at least annually? State current completion rate.
Do you run phishing simulations? State the click rate recorded in the most recent exercise.
Where is customer data physically hosted, and is it in your own facilities or a sub-service provider's?
Is physical access to hosting facilities controlled, logged and periodically reviewed?
Evidence Required: Facility attestation or sub-service provider report

Question: Are storage media securely destroyed at end of life to a recognised standard?
Does the service process our data using AI or machine learning, including for features we have not explicitly enabled?
Is our data used to train, fine-tune or evaluate any model, whether yours or a third party's?
Evidence Required: Contractual prohibition or signed written confirmation

Question: Is our data exposed to human review by your staff or contractors for quality, safety or model improvement?
Evidence Required: Human review policy and the access controls around it

Question: Name every AI sub-processor or model provider in the data path, and the retention period at each.
Evidence Required: Sub-processor register entry covering AI providers

Question: Will you accept a contractual right of audit, or an annual assurance review in place of one?
Do you carry cyber liability insurance? State the limit of indemnity.
On termination, within how many days is our data deleted, and will you certify the deletion in writing?
Do you provide transition assistance on exit, and is the scope contractually defined?
